info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Parking Reservations Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Status API provides access to check the current status of parking reservations. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about each reservation, including confirmation, availability, and associated timings. It serves as a valuable resource for parking management systems and application developers who need to integrate reservation tracking functionalities. Typical consumers include fleet operators, event organizers, and parking service providers who require real-time insights into reservation statuses.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of reservations.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current status of all reservations. It's essential for users to keep track of their bookings and understand their current state.
